title: Exponential smoothing shows raw value
symptom: Using master version 3.2.0.1 and exponential smoothing plugin, the graph is smoothed and dynISF plugin uses smoothed values, but the value that AAPS shows is the raw value received either by juggluco or xdrip, using libre 2. In previous versions the bg value shown was the smoothed one.
cause: The thread initially discusses whether showing raw value is intended. MilosKozak explains that it is currently designed to show real value because recalculated smoothed value may shift in time, and later states that in actual 3.2 code smoothed value is displayed, raw value used only when bucketed data is not generated (less than 4 recent values available).
fix: MilosKozak states that checking the actual 3.2 code, smoothed value is displayed, and raw value is used only when bucketed data is not generated (less than 4 recent values available). This indicates the issue is resolved in the code, but no explicit user action is given.
evidence_quote: Checking the actual 3.2 code and smoothed value is displayed Raw value is used only when bucketed data is not generated (less than 4 recent values available)
